defects.description: Several headers were not translated from English to Russian.
The term 'critical' (referring to a specific severity level) is translated as 'важный' (important), which is inaccurate in a technical context where 'critical' is a distinct level.
The phrase 'в отношении Объекта обсуждения' was added to the sentence and is not present in the source text.
The glossary term 'Объект обсуждения' (Subject) was replaced by the shorter lemma 'объект'.
